title: A Network can be billed per client website, on a volume ladder (LIVE-1118)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 ("Network can resell", "do it"): PR 2 of the Network website reseller program, ADR-1816.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21 as the billing FOUNDATION; nothing in the product calls it yet (the client sites list, PR 3, does). Four catalog items (network_site $39 for sites 1 to 10, network_site_mid $29 for 11 to 25, network_site_high $19 from 26, network_site_unbranded +$15 a site for badge removal), each a flat quantity line, because the ladder is graduated and the sync only mints flat prices. syncClientSiteBilling(networkId) counts the Network's live client sites (spaces.reseller_network_id, active) and makes its subscription carry exactly the lines they call for, prorated, owner-gated like extra chapters; a line whose Stripe price does not exist yet REFUSES, so a site is never added free by accident. setClientSiteBadgeRemoval grants or clears the badge_removal entitlement and re-syncs the bill, putting the grant back if the bill cannot change. Migration 20270346021000 adds spaces.reseller_network_id and widens the item_key CHECK. OPEN, owner-gated: the four Stripe products and eight prices are NOT created (the catalog sync is an admin action); creating live Stripe objects waits for the owner's yes. Catalog count pins moved 12 to 16 items (48 to 64 price keys, 13 to 17 products) in pricing-catalog.test.ts and pricing-catalog-sync.test.ts, additions only.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const k=fs.readFileSync('lib/billing/pricing-keys.ts','utf8');const b=fs.readFileSync('lib/collective/client-site-billing.ts','utf8');const bad=[];for(const i of ['network_site','network_site_mid','network_site_high','network_site_unbranded'])if(!k.includes(\"'\"+i+\"',\"))bad.push('catalog lacks '+i);if(!b.includes('syncClientSiteBilling')||!b.includes('setClientSiteBadgeRemoval'))bad.push('billing actions missing');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1118: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the client-site catalog items or the per-site billing sync go missing.
